title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S02 E08 — Holiday Hoopla
The last three bakers must show off their decorating chops by baking and beautifully decorating a sugar cookie tree; in the final heat, the bakers need to transform their assigned holiday tradition into an intricately decorated cake.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E01 — Holiday Cookie Madness
Eight bakers have to prove their cookie baking skills in the first two challenges. The first challenge requires the bakers to use an assigned baking tool and the second challenge has the bakers using different holiday ingredients.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E02 — Classic Holiday Flavors
The seven remaining bakers take classic flavors to a new level; a swirled treat using eggnog; different versions of sugar and spice for a special dessert.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E03 — It's Not the Holidays Without Pie
The six remaining bakers take on making pies; the first challenge has the bakers using a store-bought crust; the second challenge involves three different pies and three different crusts.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E04 — The Great Holiday Cake-Over
The five bakers left to compete take the fruitcake to a new level and reinvent the yule log.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E05 — Great Holiday Traditions
The four bakers must use the classic holiday flavors of peppermint and hot chocolate in a dessert and then create a holiday breakfast complete with three sweet dishes.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S01 E06 — Gingerbread Worlds
The three remaining bakers face one challenge, but it's a massive one, constructing gingerbread worlds filled with all sorts of treats.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E01 — Signs of the Season
Host Bobby Deen challenges the nine bakers to turn seasonal beverages like hot chocolate and apple cider into desserts; in the main heat, the chefs make decorative filled Bundt cake wreaths.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E02 — Grandma's Thanksgiving Favorites
Clash of the Grandmas star Norma Zager joins Bobby Deen to lend her expertise; for the pre-heat, the contestants must make two types of cookies; the bakers compete to create the best pie without the use of appliances.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E03 — Thanksgiving Joy
The remaining seven bakers create elegant trifles by combining all of their favorite Thanksgiving desserts into one; the bakers make Thanksgiving imposter cupcakes.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E04 — Hearth and Home
In the pre-heat, the remaining six bakers make desserts with toasted marshmallows; the bakers embellish traditional yule logs.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E05 — Sweet Surprises
The bakers must whip up ugly Christmas sweater desserts for the pre-heat; in the main heat, the bakers create edible gift boxes filled with treats.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E06 — Christmas Morning
The remaining four bakers recreate their childhood memories of Christmas mornings by making edible dessert stockings; the bakers build colorful cream puff Christmas trees.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S03 E07 — Live From the North Pole
The final three must make snacks for North Pole characters other than Santa; the bakers must create a North Pole-inspired cake; the winner gets the title Holiday Baking Champion and a $50,000 prize.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S04 E01 — Holiday Party Delights
Bakers create eye-catching and tantalizing new holiday treats for seasonal parties; bakers create a dessert with an unusual candy cane flavor; for the main heat, they use a holiday cocktail as sweet inspiration; one unlucky baker goes home.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S04 E02 — Season Of Sharing
In the pre-heat, eight bakers team up to make a dozen hand pies in a festive holiday shape; for the main heat, bakers create a holiday dessert duo inspired by classic holiday flavor combinations.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S04 E03 — Thanksgiving Genius
In the pre-heat, seven bakers must create a Thanksgiving dessert using a mystery canned fruit; in the main heat, bakers whip up new Turkey Day sensations by combining two traditional desserts.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S04 E04 — A New Holiday Spin
The six remaining bakers create new takes on traditional holiday baking; inspired by an internet baking meme, for the pre-heat they use yellow cake mix to make anything but cake; in the main heat, bakers must holiday up a non-holiday dessert.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S04 E05 — Comfort and Joy
The five remaining bakers ignite the holiday spirit with a fiery, pre-heat dessert; in the main heat, they take a traditional holiday cheese board and turn it into an unusual cheesecake.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S04 E06 — Tradition! Tradition!
The four remaining bakers celebrate two classic holiday traditions: Hanukkah jelly doughnuts and ye olde fruitcake.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S04 E07 — Twelve Days Of Christmas
Final three bakers grab two last minute holiday gifts and combine them into one impressive dessert.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
Runners Up Redemption
Hosts and judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Lorraine Pascale welcome back runner-up teams from previous seasons to battle it out for another chance to win.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S05 E01 — Holiday Essentials
The pumpkin spice phenomenon hits the championship; for the pre-heat, nine bakers attempt to wow the judges with creative pumpkin spiciness; in the main heat, the bakers must combine a yule log with a classic holiday treat.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S05 E02 — Plenty of Gratitude
For the pre-heat, the eight bakers work in teams to make four different kinds of pies on the same sheet pan; in the main heat, the bakers embrace the stuffed feeling after the Thanksgiving meal by making stuffed cakes featuring seasonal ingredients.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S05 E03 — Turkey Day Delights
Seven bakers must make a dessert combining cranberry with another flavor; to combat the sleepiness that follows turkey, the main heat challenges the bakers to create a sweet treat that pairs coffee with an unusual flavor of coffee syrup.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S05 E04 — Holiday Artistry
The holidays are a time for artistry and decorations, so for the pre-heat, inflatable holiday decorations inspire the six bakers' cute cream puff displays; in the main heat, the bakers dazzle the judges with delicious hand-painted eggnog cakes.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S05 E05 — Light and Inspiring
Five bakers have to update traditional rugelach with unexpected new flavors like cardamom, grapefruit, guava paste, peanut butter or chai; the judges are craving their favorite ingredients in the form of a light and creamy tiramisu in the main heat.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S05 E06 — New Family Classics
In the pre-heat, bakers have to combine common pantry ingredients like balsamic vinegar, potato chips, oatmeal, red wine and olive oil in a new version of a classic holiday dessert; the bakers must use two key fruitcake components in a new dessert.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S05 E07 — Gifts of Greatness
Three final bakers must create a beautiful edible holiday ornament display in the pre-heat; for the final main heat, the bakers must create a cake that is decorated like a gift on the outside and reveals a surprise inside when sliced.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
Homecoming Special
Six previous Holiday Baking Championship winners step back into the kitchen for a new competition judged by Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Lorraine Pascale.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
Christmas in July
Four talented bakers celebrate Christmas twice a year; host Jesse Palmer leads them through hotly contested challenges focused on melted snowman desserts and cool and creamy Christmas ice cream cakes.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E01 — Gearing Up for the Holidays
Host Jesse Palmer asks the 10 bakers to introduce themselves with edible place cards; the competitors must bake and decorate a Danish kransekake featuring holiday ingredients like chestnuts, graham crackers or toffee.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E02 — Sweet Revenge
Three runners-up from previous competitions are back, and all they want for Christmas is a second chance to win; each baker takes on a judge's favorite holiday dessert; the bakers create holiday centerpiece cakes.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E03 — Filling Grateful
Using the crowd-pleasing holiday gift to create spiced nut desserts, each baker must make three pies using an assigned harvest ingredient and decorate each pie crust differently.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E04 — Holiday Survival Guide
Jesse Palmer offers tips for surviving holiday madness while sharing highlights, including amazing desserts and hilarious banter.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E05 — Thanksgiving It My All
Apple cider doughnuts are a sure sign of fall; Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to create a dozen kicked-up apple cider doughnuts decorated with seasonal themes; the bakers must transform a classic holiday yule log into a festive Thanksgiving roll cake.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E06 — Trendsetting Turkey Day
Jesse Palmer tasks the seven bakers with taking a beloved holiday appetizer to a whole new level with baked Brie and jam mini pies; the bakers take a prepared ingredient and use it to make a Thanksgiving dessert.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E07 — Gettin' Gifty With It
Jesse Palmer teaches the bakers a lesson in repurposing holiday gifts when they must turn panettone into an entirely new dessert; then they're challenged to create a beautifully decorated cupcake mosaic inspired by a pair of holiday pajamas.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E08 — North Pole Vaulting
The five bakers create assigned desserts that are inspired by and look like Santa Claus; the bakers are tasked with creating impressive cakes made to look like another icy North Pole staple.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E09 — Traditions With a Twist
Some of the tastiest treats of Hanukkah are gold-covered chocolate coins, and Jesse Palmer challenges the four remaining bakers to give the classic treat a twist by incorporating candied orange, espresso beans, smoked salt or toasted coconut.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S06 E10 — Christmas Day Delights
Jesse Palmer challenges the three remaining bakers to make a Christmas morning brunch using the classic holiday flavors of gingerbread, cinnamon and eggnog.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S07 E01 — Holiday Style
Jesse Palmer kicks off the competition by challenging 12 bakers to make holiday decorated quick bread wreaths with assigned flavors.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S07 E02 — Holiday Goodie Games
Jesse Palmer asks the 10 bakers to highlight a nut or seed in a holiday dessert; then, the competitors must use a fundamental holiday ingredient in unseasonable desserts, like icebox cakes or fruit tarts.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S07 E03 — Take Holiday Pies by Surprise
Host Jesse Palmer asks the nine bakers to make holiday cookie-topped mini pies; the competitors celebrate fall with flavor combos; pumpkin-cider and chestnut-chocolate in cream pies; lattice pies.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S07 E04 — Hosting the Holidays
The challenge for the eight bakers is to turn breakfast items into Thanksgiving desserts; Friendsgiving potluck-inspired desserts are made to impress judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Carla Hall.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S07 E05 — It's What's on the Inside That Counts
Host Jesse Palmer gives the seven bakers advent calendars filled with chocolate to inspire them to make desserts with a surprise inside. Then, for the main heat, the competitors must bake one delicious cheesecake with three different flavors.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S07 E06 — Topsy-Turvy Holidays
Jesse Palmer challenges the competitors to work in teams to create a twist on traditional Hanukkah jelly doughnuts; the bakers get creative with holiday decorated upside-down cakes to satisfy the judges.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S07 E07 — A Classic Christmas
Host Jesse Palmer asks the five bakers to create an over-the-top version of a holiday trifle. Then, the classics continue in the main heat when the competitors make the ultimate Charlotte royale for judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Carla Hall.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S07 E08 — Christmas Windows in Time
Jesse Palmer kicks things off by asking the final four competitors to create a holiday macaron tower. In the main heat, the bakers must feature an assigned icing style -- marzipan, buttercream or mirror glaze -- in a stunning cake to win $25,000.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
Sweet Secrets
The judges take a behind-the-scenes look at the journey to the finale.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S08 E01 — Falling Into Winter
The 12 bakers embrace the seasonal transition by making fall and winter doughnuts; the competitors combine holiday cheese board staples in creative apple and cheese desserts.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S08 E02 — Yule Be Merry
The bakers team up to take on boozy desserts and are challenged with five different styles of yule log cakes in 10 different flavor combinations.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S08 E03 — Attitude of Gratitude
The nine bakers make Mason jar fruit desserts; the competitors create heartfelt messages on top of a favorite Thanksgiving dessert: pie.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S08 E04 — Best Thanksgiving Ever
In a nod to the day after Thanksgiving, the bakers use Black Friday kitchen gadgets to make desserts; the competitors work in teams to create cornucopia bread baskets filled with flavored holiday breads.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S08 E05 — Gifts That Keep on Giving
In honor of the Hanukkah oil that kept burning, the seven remaining bakers must create festive Hanukkah olive oil cakes; in the main heat, the competitors randomly choose a dreaded holiday dessert and attempt to spin it into holiday happiness.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S08 E06 — Make New Friends, but Keep the Old
The six remaining bakers make tasty treats for guests with a dietary restriction; host Jesse Palmer challenges the competitors to update an assigned vintage holiday dessert to create a new Christmas delight.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S08 E07 — Holidays in All the Ways
Host Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to create sweet potato and spice desserts in honor of Kwanzaa; in the main heat, the competitors make Christmas card cakes that depict a perfect family snapshot for a holiday card.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S08 E08 — Ultimate Holiday Party
The bakers create dessert charcuterie boards and piñata desserts, then the competitors take on holiday party theme cakes and incorporate lights into their designs; the most successful baker becomes the Holiday Baking Champion and gets $25,000!

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S09 E01 — First Snow
Jesse Palmer welcomes the 12 bakers by challenging them to create fall pavlova wreaths; the competitors divide into cake and pie teams to finally decide the best holiday dessert and win immunity from judges Nancy Fuller, Duff Goldman and Carla Hall.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S09 E02 — Getting Ready for Thanksgiving
Jesse Palmer tasks the bakers with creating desserts featuring ingredients from Thanksgiving dinner; the competitors go beyond cookies to give the jolly gingerbread man a makeover to impress the judges.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S09 E03 — Feeling Sweet and Thankful
Smoked, fried, brined, roasted and bacon-wrapped, Jesse Palmer uses the five-way turkey as inspiration for the bakers' preheat challenge; the competitors divide into teams to create a flight of pies that takes the judges on a flavorful journey.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S09 E04 — Dining Out for the Holidays
Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to turn steakhouse desserts into decadent holiday treats; then, the competitors impress the judges by transforming a traditional steakhouse icon into a tasty Christmas tree.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S09 E05 — Holiday Movie Magic
Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to create a holiday high tea; the bakers get inspired by a holiday movie trope to create a dessert that's dripping with festive decorations.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S09 E06 — The World of Holidays
In honor of Kwanzaa, Jesse Palmer tasks the bakers with crafting desserts that feature fresh corn for a traditional Kwanzaa display; the competitors put their personal stamp on international holiday desserts.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S09 E07 — Holiday Rush
The bakers feel the holiday rush as Jesse Palmer sends them through three heated challenges: create ugly sweater cakes, turn store-bought cake into tasty centerpieces and build a snowman croquembouche.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S09 E08 — Happy Holiday Getaways
Jesse Palmer escapes the cold weather by challenging the bakers to create dessert-inspired succulent tarts, and two competitors are sent skiing into a cookie cake showdown.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S01 E01 — When the Elves Call in Sick
Three teams of confectionery artists face off to see who can make a holiday display that shows who steps in to save the day after Santa's elves call in sick on Christmas Eve.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S01 E02 — Stealing the Naughty List
Jonathan Bennett asks the five teams to create a jolly depiction of a heist involving the world's naughtiest kids stealing Santa's famous Naughty List.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S01 E03 — Elf Auditions
The four remaining teams of cake masters and sugar artists create their most festive vision of how Santa Claus auditions his next crop of elves.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S01 E04 — Santa's New Gig
Jonathan Bennett challenges the three remaining teams of cake and sugar artists to show how Santa celebrates the off-season with a side job.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S01 E05 — Elves vs. Reindeer
The two remaining teams of cake masters and sugar artists face off for their final festive battle for a grand prize of $25,000.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E01 — Surprise Holiday Parade
Five teams of cake and sugar artists compete to impress the judges as Santa makes a spur-of-the-moment decision to throw a holiday parade.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E02 — Santa to the Rescue!
Five teams of cake and sugar artists must imagine what happens outside the North Pole and make a creation symbolizing Santa Claus as a world hero.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E03 — The Great Turkey Escape
Five teams of master cake and sugar artists create what happens when all the Thanksgiving turkeys decide to make a break for it.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E04 — When Toys Come Alive ... And Go Wild
The five teams show the judges what happens when too much holiday magic happens and newly minted toys come alive, escape from their boxes and go crazy.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E05 — Critter Christmas
The four remaining teams of cake and sugar artists must create the most bizarre visions of a Christmas party in the animal kingdom.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S02 E06 — North Pole Wedding
Raven-Symoné challenges the four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists to imagine the most romantic wedding the world has ever seen at the North Pole; judges Shinmin Li and Erin Acevedo decide which team will go home with $25,000.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S03 E01 — Reindeer Auditions
In the first qualifying round, the three teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase an unlikely understudy who dreams of winning a spot to pull Santa's sleigh; two teams move on in the competition and the judges send one team home.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S03 E02 — A Cake-mas Carol
In the second qualifying round, three teams are challenged to showcase Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol" in a way the world has never seen before by completely reimagining the iconic ghost of Christmas past, present or future.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S03 E03 — Wild Thanksgiving
In the final qualifying round, three teams have to showcase how two animals that don't ordinarily get along can celebrate Thanksgiving together in the animal kingdom.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S03 E04 — The Ultimate Snowball Fight
With the qualifying rounds complete, six teams of masterful cake and sugar artists face off in a challenge to imagine the perfect way to win the ultimate snowball fight.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S03 E05 — Intergalactic Holidays
The five remaining teams of cake and sugar artists are challenged to imagine friendly aliens celebrating their own holidays on another planet; at the end of the face-off, the field of competition narrows with one team's elimination.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S03 E06 — Holiday Sing-Along
The four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists are challenged to bring the story of a carol to life using their imagination, with cake.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S03 E07 — Merry Grinchmas!
In the penultimate battle, three teams of master cake and sugar artists bring Dr. Seuss' iconic "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" to life by re-imagining the world-famous story as a big-screen epic in a whole new movie genre.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S03 E08 — Santa's New Ride
With $25,000 and the title of Holiday Wars Champion at stake, the last two teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase the wildest, most powerful, modernization imaginable for Santa's new ride.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
Champion Cake Off
The reigning champions of "Halloween Wars" and "Holiday Wars" face off in a New Year's themed battle involving team mascots and champagne-inspired cakes; the winning team gets a trip to New York City for the biggest New Year's party in the world.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E01 — Platform 9 3/4
The nine baking pairs create a piece that shows their love for Harry Potter.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E02 — Gringotts Wizarding Bank
The teams are in Gringotts Wizarding Bank, where James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create 3-foot showpieces inspired by the bank's main hall, tunnels and vaults.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E03 — Diagon Alley
In a salute to the famed shops of Diagon Alley, hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the bakers to make 50 handheld desserts to feed a crowd of Harry Potter fans, who vote on a winner; judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team must go.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E04 — The Forbidden Forest
James and Oliver Phelps host as pairs of professional bakers create edible showpieces on the actual Harry Potter film sets; guest actors from the films share behind the scenes experiences as they join judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E05 — Dumbledore's Office
James and Oliver Phelps ask bakers to create a four-foot-tall showpiece inspired by Albus Dumbledore's office items; Harry Potter alumna Bonnie Wright joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef to decide which teams advance to the final showdown.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S01 E06 — The Great Hall
Creating a showpiece that reaches at least 6 feet tall and commemorates at least one event that takes place in the Great Hall; the bakers must also include two culinary effects and incorporate at least two tasting elements; surprise guests arrive.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E01 — The House Duels
James and Oliver Phelps assign eight pairs of pastry wizards into the four Hogwarts Houses and ask them to create a showpiece with at least one tasting element; Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which bakers move on to the next challenge.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E02 — Wizard's Journey
In front of the Knight Bus, James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining six teams to make transportation-inspired showpieces that incorporate classic English desserts; guest Devon Murray joins Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S02 E03 — The Edible Artifacts
Inspired by Polyjuice Potion, James and Oliver Phelps challenge the five remaining teams to recreate two items as hyperrealistic edible showpieces; judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team made the most convincing and delicious artifact.
